segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: We'll start with the girl. She's

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: going to receive a cookie. Her

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: brother is taking cookies out of a jar.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: And he got careless. She's asking him for one. So he's handing one down to her. In the meantime, he is getting ready to fall off of a

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: stool, a three-legged stool. And the mother's not paying much attention. She's looking out the window.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: And in looking out the window while she's letting her sink run over in the water, splashing on the floor all over her.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: and she has two cups and a plate on the table. Well,

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: I did say she was letting the water run down onto the floor splashing onto her feet.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: Then I climbed the tree. I'm going to

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: see my child. There's a plate, two cups.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: Oh, I did say she's letting the water run over the sink, didn't I? Yes. Cold and wind drying. Seems to be looking out the window while she's drying her dishes. Well, it's... How about that?
